workflow: Manually entering and updating customer records in the CRM by copy-pasting from spreadsheets and other systems.
trigger: Whenever a new lead or account is created, or existing customer data changes.
current_workaround: Using Excel spreadsheets as an intermediate staging area for data cleaning before uploading to the CRM.
consequence: Data entry errors, duplicate records, and delayed sales follow-up due to time spent on manual tasks.

workflow: Exporting contact lists and engagement data from the CRM and importing them into email marketing tools, then reconciling the resulting campaign data back into the CRM.
trigger: Every marketing campaign launch and post-campaign analysis.
current_workaround: Running manual CSV exports/imports and using spreadsheet formulas to enrich and segment data across tools.
consequence: Stale or inconsistent data across systems, poor lead attribution, and wasted hours that could be spent on high-impact marketing activities.

workflow: Reconciling CRM opportunity data with billing and invoicing systems by pulling data from both and manually matching line items in spreadsheets.
trigger: Monthly close and quarterly business reviews.
current_workaround: Exporting reports from the CRM and billing software, then using Excel pivot tables and VLOOKUPs to find discrepancies.
consequence: Revenue recognition errors, delays in financial reporting, and time-consuming audits due to missing traceability.

workflow: Generating compliance reports (e.g., GDPR access requests, audit logs) by manually querying the CRM and exporting data to spreadsheets for formatting and review.
trigger: Each compliance request or regulatory audit.
current_workaround: Using custom SQL queries and Excel templates to produce required documentation.
consequence: Slow response times to legal requests, risk of missing data, and non-compliance penalties.

workflow: Building and maintaining internal scripts or third-party workarounds to compensate for missing CRM customizations and integrations.
trigger: Whenever the existing system lacks a specific feature or stable integration needed by the business.
current_workaround: Developing custom scripts, hiring consultants, or using unofficial APIs to pull/push data between poorly integrated systems.
consequence: High technical debt, costly maintenance, and constant breakage when systems update their APIs.
